content: The recorded second link invocation finished ten seconds faster than the first.
claims: Both recorded link invocations used eight workers.

sources.text: Release-build comparison RB-8. The first link invocation took 22 seconds. The next invocation took 12 seconds after the new linker plugin was enabled. Between those invocations, the object-file cache also changed from empty to populated. Both invocations used eight workers. There is no run varying the plugin while holding cache contents fixed; the engineer recorded the two durations without assigning the ten-second difference to either change.

content: The authoritative zone served api.lab.example with a TTL of 300 seconds at the 09:05 audit.
claims: Both audited zone revisions delegate lab.example to ns7.lab.example.

sources.text: Authoritative DNS zone audit for lab.example, 2026-08-03 UTC. Revision Z41 served api.lab.example with TTL 900 seconds until 09:00. Revision Z42 became active at 09:00 and changed that TTL to 300 seconds. The audit at 09:05 identifies Z42 as the served revision and reads TTL 300 from it. Both revisions delegate the zone to nameserver ns7.lab.example. The audit says nothing about cached copies held by recursive resolvers.
